title: Normalized multiplication of support quotient sheaves on products
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use ordinary sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], on small representatives of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Derived categories are unbounded localizations at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] and a closed immersion $a:C\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], write $j:T\setminus C\hookrightarrow T$ for its open complement and set
$$Q^\tau_{T,C}=\operatorname{coker}(j_!\underline A_{T\setminus C}\longrightarrow\underline A_T),\qquad \tau=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet},$$
where the arrow is induced by inclusion of the open object into the final object and extension by zero is [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Denote the quotient map by $r^\tau_{T,C}$. Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $Z\hookrightarrow X$, $W\hookrightarrow Y$ be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $P=X\times_kY$, $S=Z\times_kW$, with projections $p_X,p_Y$ [def-pc-base-change]. In each topology multiplication of quotient generators specifies an isomorphism
$$e_\tau:p_X^*Q^\tau_{X,Z}\otimes_A p_Y^*Q^\tau_{Y,W}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q^\tau_{P,S},\qquad \overline a\otimes\overline b\longmapsto\overline{ab}.$$
Here tensor is the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and pullback uses the constant coefficient inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The same map is an isomorphism for derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-weil-derived-tensor]. The maps $e_\tau$ are natural for maps of the two pairs of schemes and closed supports inducing the pullbacks in this formula.

source.place: Proof paragraph 4: multiplication of quotient generators identifies the product support quotient, with the etale and pro-etale normalizations.
